function.name: get_market_price
function.description: Get current market prices for an EVE Online item in The Forge region (Jita hub). Returns best sell price, best buy price, and order counts. Set hub (jita, amarr, dodixie, rens, hek) for the orders at that trade hub's main station; without hub the answer covers the whole region of The Forge.

type_id.description: The EVE type ID of the item (e.g. 34 for Tritanium, 44992 for PLEX)

type_name.description: Human-readable item name, for display only

hub.description: Trade hub whose main station's orders to read, e.g. 'amarr'. Omit for the whole region of The Forge. Ignored for PLEX.

function.name: get_type_info
function.description: Get information about an EVE Online item: name, description, volume, mass, group.

function.name: search_item_by_name
function.description: Resolve one or more EVE Online item, ship, or module names to their type_id. Call this BEFORE get_market_price or get_type_info when you only have a name, not a type_id.

names.description: List of item/ship/module names to resolve, e.g. ['Stabber', 'PLEX', 'Gila']

details.description: true: one line of facts per item (group, category, meta group and level, market group, volume, Alpha usability) for up to 50 names; use it to classify a list ('which of these are Tech II or faction')

function.name: get_ship_stats
function.description: Get slot layout, hardpoints, and resource limits for an EVE Online ship. Call this BEFORE generating a fit to know exact hi/mid/low/rig slot counts, turret and launcher hardpoints, CPU capacity (tf), and powergrid capacity (MW). Using these values prevents generating fits that exceed slot or resource limits.

function.name: get_ship_bonuses
function.description: Get hull bonuses for an EVE Online ship — per-skill-level bonuses + role bonuses + ship class. Call this BEFORE generating a fit so you pick the bonused weapon system (Caldari hybrid vs missile, Gallente drone vs hybrid, Minmatar projectile vs missile, Amarr laser; pirate hulls have specific role bonuses like web range or ECM). The response names every per-skill bonus and any role bonus from the ship's ESI description — use those to decide weapons, modules, and tank type.

ship_name.description: Ship type name, e.g. 'Hawk', 'Stabber Fleet Issue', 'Daredevil', 'Gila'

function.name: find_canonical_module
function.description: Look up canonical SDE typeNames for a module family (e.g. 'Steel Plates', 'Entropic Radiation Sink', 'Shield Extender', 'Heat Sink', 'Magnetic Field Stabilizer', 'Ballistic Control System', 'Stasis Webifier', 'Microwarpdrive', 'Remote Armor Repairer'). Call this when you are about to write a module that isn't in the `compatible_weapons` or `bonused_modules` of get_hull_facts and you are not 100% sure of the canonical name. Optional `size` narrows to a class prefix — 'Small' for frigates / destroyers, 'Medium' for cruisers / battlecruisers, 'Large' for battleships and capitals. Returns a short list of real published items (no SKINs / Blueprints / Specializations). Search mode (when slot, kind, meta or limit is set): list modules, charges or drones by slot, kind and meta group, e.g. family 'Shield' + slot 'mid', in name order with CPU and powergrid, up to 30 per call with the total. Example: {"family":"Shield Extender","slot":"mid","meta":"Tech II"}.

family.description: Module family substring, e.g. 'Steel Plates', 'Entropic Radiation Sink', 'Tracking Enhancer'

slot.description: Search mode: only modules that fit this slot, e.g. 'mid'

kind.description: Search mode: what to list (default module). Charges and drones have no slot.

meta.description: Search mode: meta group name, e.g. 'Tech II', 'Faction', 'Deadspace', 'Officer', 'Abyssal'

limit.description: Search mode: items to list (1-30, default 10)

function.name: get_hull_facts
function.description: Authoritative SDE snapshot of a hull's fitting envelope — slot/hardpoint counts, drone bay, role/skill bonuses, AND the canonical list of weapons that hull is restricted to fit (when EVE encodes a per-hull weapon lock). Call this BEFORE writing an EFT block on any unfamiliar / specialist hull (Triglavian battleships Leshak / Drekavac → Supratidal Entropic Disintegrators; Triglavian frigates → Light variants; Triglavian cruisers → Heavy variants; pirate / faction hulls). When `compatible_weapons` is non-empty, USE ONLY those typeNames — anything else will be rejected by validate_fitting. When `compatible_weapons` is empty there is no per-hull lock; rely on `role_bonuses` (which carry the bonused weapon family like 'Small Hybrid Turret' or 'Light Missile') and standard hardpoint sizing.

function.name: get_fits
function.description: Retrieve community ship fits VERBATIM from the indexed fit database (EVE Workbench + Abysstracker + gustavmannfred.streamlit.app + caldarijoans.streamlit.app, ~8150 fits). Use this FIRST whenever the user asks for popular / community / top / proven / 'most-used' / meta / 'best' / Gustav's / CaldariJoans' fits — never invent a fit when this tool can answer. Returns the raw EFT text (header + modules + drones + ammo) and the source URL for each match. Filter by ship_name (exact), activity (pvp / pve / hauler / exploration / mining / logistics), context (wh, abyss, abyss-electrical / firestorm / exotic / gamma / dark, abyss-t1..t6, ratting, solo), cost_class (cheap < 50M / mid 50-500M / blingy > 500M ISK), alpha_clone (true for Alpha-skill-friendly), combat_role (solo / fleet — zKillboard only). If 0 matches, returns 'NO FITS FOUND' — follow the STEP decision tree: try ONE retry with the most restrictive filter dropped, then proceed to STEP 2 and generate a theorycrafted fit from game knowledge. NEVER tell the user this tool returned empty.

ship_name.description: Exact EVE ship name. Examples: 'Tengu', 'Gila', 'Hurricane Fleet Issue', 'Vexor Navy Issue'. Leave empty to search across all ships matching the other filters.

activity.description: Activity the fit is meant for.

alpha_clone.description: If true, only return fits flyable on Alpha skills.

combat_role.description: Workbench-derived role tag for PvP fits.

source.description: Restrict to one source. Leave empty to search all sources. Use 'gustavmannfred' for Gustav's abyss fits (gustavmannfred.streamlit.app), 'caldarijoans' for CaldariJoans' abyss fits (caldarijoans.streamlit.app). Pass this when the user explicitly asks for a specific author's fit.

limit.description: Max number of fits to return (default 5, hard max 10).

fit_id.description: Fetch one fit by its id (a UUID from the id= field of get_fits or list_fits). The other filters are ignored. Example: '6f1d3b2a-0c4e-5a7b-9d8e-1f2a3b4c5d6e'.

include_eft.description: Default true. false leaves the EFT blocks out and lists only the meta line and id of each fit, to browse cheaply before fetching one with fit_id.

function.name: list_fits
function.description: LIST / enumerate community fits from the indexed fit database by exact payload filters (NOT semantic search). Use when the user wants to SEE WHAT FITS EXIST — 'list all fits for X', 'what Gila fits do you have', 'how many workbench fits', 'show every abyss-t5 fit' — rather than one fit to copy. Returns a compact numbered list (ship — fit name | tags | source URL) plus the TOTAL match count. Filter by source, ship_name (exact), tag (a fit_tags value like 'pve' / 'pvp' / 'abyss-t5' / 'cheap' / 'alpha-clone'), and filament_type. Use get_fits instead when the user wants the actual modules to copy.

source.description: Restrict to one fit source. Empty = all fit sources.

ship_name.description: Exact EVE ship name to filter by (e.g. 'Gila'). Empty = all ships.

tag.description: A fit_tags value to filter by: pvp / pve / abyss / abyss-t1..t6 / wh / cheap / blingy / alpha-clone / solo / fleet, etc.

filament_type.description: Abysstracker filament: electrical / firestorm / exotic / gamma / dark.

limit.description: Max rows to list (default 24, hard max 24: the list is capped, not exportable).

function.name: analyze_battle
function.description: Analyze a battle report from zKillboard, WarBeacon, or br.evetools.org. Call this when the user pastes a zKillboard URL containing '/related/' or '/br/', a WarBeacon URL containing '/br/report/', or a br.evetools.org URL containing '/br/{24-hex-id}'. Returns kills, ISK destroyed, ship composition, and duration. Pass detail='full' to additionally include a per-weapon damage breakdown and a per-slot list of destroyed modules — use this on the user's follow-up when they ask for damage / weapons / modules / components / what killed.

battle_url.description: Full battle URL. Supported formats: https://zkillboard.com/related/30003067/202501071700/ or https://zkillboard.com/br/4885/ or https://warbeacon.net/br/report/78f57bba-34b0-4e0b-b0e6-53119ab32fbc or https://br.evetools.org/br/69f7d88dcbe9de00126eb5a5

detail.description: Output level. 'summary' (default) — high-level battle report only. 'full' — also includes top-10 damage by weapon type per side and top-10 destroyed modules per slot per side. Slower (~5-15 s) since it fetches individual killmails; for br.evetools.org reports only the 25 most valuable are read, one at a time. The result is cached for 30 min so a follow-up turn is fast.

function.name: validate_fitting
function.description: Validate an EVE Online ship fitting in EFT format. Checks CPU, powergrid, and slot counts against ship attributes assuming Engineering V (+25% PG) and Electronics V (+25% CPU) — the realistic baseline every PvP / abyss capable character has. Call this after generating a fit to confirm it is valid before presenting it to the user.

eft_text.description: Full fitting in EFT format, starting with [Ship Name, Fit Name]

function.name: compute_fit_stats
function.description: Compute the real stats of an EVE Online fit from its EFT text with the dogma engine (all-V skills, no implants): DPS per weapon group with the charge used, volley, EHP per layer with resists, max speed (propulsion on), align time, capacitor stability and CPU/PG load. Call this whenever the user asks for a fit's DPS, EHP, tank, speed, align or cap stability - never estimate these by hand. Weapons with no charge on their EFT line get a default T1 ammo (Scourge missiles; Phased Plasma / Antimatter / Multifrequency for turrets), which the output labels.

eft_text.description: Full fitting in EFT format, starting with [Ship Name, Fit Name]. Loaded ammo may be given as 'Module, Charge' lines.

charges.description: Optional ammo to use instead of the default, as {module name: charge name}, e.g. {"Rocket Launcher II": "Mjolnir Rocket"}. Only for weapons with no charge on their EFT line.

function.name: appraise_items
function.description: Appraise a list of EVE Online items and return the total ISK value. Without a Janice key the answer is an estimate from EVE's average prices (ESI /markets/prices, refreshed daily), not live Jita buy or sell prices. With a Janice key it is a Janice appraisal: Jita buy, sell and split totals and a link to the full appraisal. The answer names its price source: pass it on, and call an estimate an estimate.

items.description: Items one per line with a quantity: multi-buy ('Tritanium x1000' or 'Tritanium 1000'), an inventory or contract copy, or an EFT fit

function.name: get_production_chain
function.description: Compute the full material breakdown to manufacture an EVE Online item, recursively expanding sub-components down to base minerals and PI commodities. Use this for 'how many minerals to build X' or 'production chain for X' questions. Optional advanced params let the user model a specific structure rig + system cost index (e.g., 'in 1DQ1-A with Minmatar manufacturing rig 4 and 5% cost index'). With system it reads that system's live manufacturing cost index from ESI and prices the job fee in ISK; with include_cost it adds the ISK value of the materials at ESI average prices and a total. Planetary commodities (P1-P4) answer with their schematic chain down to P0 raw resources: runs counts cycles of the final schematic, ME, rigs and cost indices do not apply (system is accepted, reads nothing, and still counts as a live call), and include_cost values the raw resources. Without system or include_cost it is SDE-only.

item_name.description: Item or ship name to build, e.g. 'Revelation', 'Avatar', 'Rifter'

me_level.description: Material Efficiency level 0-10 (default 10 — fully researched BPO)

station_rig_level.description: Structure rig material-savings level 0-5 (default 0). M-Set Manufacturing Material Efficiency rig at level 5 = 10% material savings. Use only when the user explicitly mentions a structure or its rigs.

system_cost_index.description: System manufacturing cost index 0.0-0.20 (default 0.0). Adds a job fee note: job cost = estimated item value × (cost index + facility tax + 4% SCC surcharge), where the estimated item value is the ME 0 inputs at ESI adjusted prices and an NPC station charges 0.25% facility tax; a player structure sets its own facility tax and its bonuses lower the cost index part, and each sub-component job pays its own fee. Set to the user's quoted system index when they ask for a fee estimate, or give system to read it.

system.description: Solar system where the job runs, e.g. 'Jita'. Reads its current manufacturing cost index from ESI and prices the job fee in ISK (live: counts against the live limit). Give this or system_cost_index, not both.

include_cost.description: true adds the ISK value of the materials at ESI daily average prices and, with system or system_cost_index, the job fee and a total. Default false.

facility_tax_pct.description: Facility tax of the structure in percent, 0 to 10 (default 0.25, an NPC station). Used for the job fee.

industry_skills.description: Optional industry skills dict. Currently honoured: 'production_efficiency' (0-5) for legacy ME-savings adjustment. Modern EVE folded most industry skills into ME research; this is the remaining axis worth modelling explicitly.

function.name: get_jumps_between
function.description: Compute the number of jumps and the route between two EVE solar systems. Default route is shortest (any security). Set prefer_high_sec=true to prefer highsec-only paths (longer but safer). Set detail='summary' for one line (jump count, lowest-security hop, highsec/lowsec/nullsec counts and the highsec-only alternative) instead of the hop list. avoid: systems never to route through (up to 20); via: systems to pass through in order (up to 5).

prefer_high_sec.description: If true, route via highsec only (default false)

detail.description: 'route' (default) lists every hop; 'summary' answers in one line

avoid.description: Systems never to route through (up to 20), e.g. ['Ahbazon']. The origin and destination are never avoided.

via.description: Systems to pass through, in order (up to 5), e.g. ['Dodixie']

function.name: get_jump_distances
function.description: Jump counts from one origin system to up to 200 other systems in one call (one search over the stargate graph). Use it to rank candidates by distance, e.g. 'which of these systems is nearest to C-N4OD'. One line per system, nearest first; unknown names and systems without a gate route (wormhole space) are listed separately. prefer_high_sec counts highsec-only routes where one exists.

systems.description: Solar system names to measure, e.g. ['Elonaya','Uchomida','Actee']

prefer_high_sec.description: If true, count highsec-only routes where one exists (default false)

avoid.description: Systems never to pass through (up to 20), e.g. ['Ahbazon']; a target you also list here still gets its own count, but no route passes through it.

function.name: plan_jump_route
function.description: Plan a jump-drive route like a capital pilot's jump planner, for a jump freighter, Rorqual, Black Ops, carrier, dreadnought, Lancer, FAX, supercarrier or titan (give the hull name), or 'Jump Bridge' for a chain of Ansiblex jump bridges (5 ly): the fewest jumps from origin to destination through optional waypoints, then the fewest light-years. Every hop ends where a cynosural field can be lit (lowsec or nullsec; never highsec, wormhole space, Pochven or Zarzakh); capitals cannot start in highsec. One line per hop: region, system, security, NPC stations, light-years, the gate jumps between the same two systems and the isotopes burned; then the totals (light-years, fuel and its m³). Skills default to level 5. Titans, Black Ops and the Rorqual can also bridge, and carriers, supercarriers, Black Ops and the Rorqual can conduit jump, over the same hops; that fuel is not counted. Example: {"origin":"Amamake","destination":"1DQ1-A","ship":"Rhea"}. avoid_incursions and live_info read live ESI data and count against the live-data limit; without them the route comes from the SDE alone.

destination.description: Last stop, a solar system name, e.g. '1DQ1-A'

ship.description: Hull name, e.g. 'Rhea', 'Rorqual', 'Avatar', 'Panther', or 'Jump Bridge' for Ansiblex jump bridges

waypoints.description: Systems the route must stop at, in order (up to 5), e.g. ["Sahda"]

skills.description: Skill levels 0-5 (default 5 each), e.g. {"jump_drive_calibration": 4}. Jump freighters also use jump_freighters.

jump_drive_calibration.description: Jump Drive Calibration level, +20% range per level

jump_fuel_conservation.description: Jump Fuel Conservation level, -10% fuel per level

jump_freighters.description: Jump Freighters level (jump freighters only), -10% fuel per level

avoid.description: Systems no hop may end in (up to 20), e.g. ['Tegheon']

avoid_regions.description: Regions no hop may end in (up to 10), e.g. ["Khanid"]

prefer_stations.description: If true, among the routes with the fewest jumps prefer hops that end in systems with an NPC station (default false)

avoid_incursions.description: Read the active incursions from ESI (live) and never end a hop in an infested system; incursions jam cynosural fields. Costs one live call.

live_info.description: Add each hop system's sovereignty holder and last-hour jumps and kills from ESI (live). Costs one live call.

function.name: get_systems_in_region
function.description: List solar systems in an EVE region filtered by security band. Use for 'which lowsec systems in X' or 'highsec in Y' questions.

function.name: get_lp_offers
function.description: List the loyalty point (LP) store of an NPC corporation and rank its offers by the ISK each loyalty point is worth. ISK per LP = (average price of the items given - the ISK cost - the average price of the required items) / the LP cost. The prices are ESI's daily average prices, not live market orders, so treat the figures as a guide; an offer with an item that has no average price (a blueprint copy has none) shows no ISK per LP and says why. A corporation without a store says so. Example: {"corporation":"Caldari Navy","limit":5}. Another: Sisters of EVE offers matching 'probe', cheapest in LP first: {"corporation":"Sisters of EVE","item":"probe","sort":"lp_cost"}.

corporation.description: NPC corporation name, e.g. 'Caldari Navy', 'Sisters of EVE', 'Federation Navy'

item.description: Keep offers whose item name contains this text, e.g. 'shield'

sort.description: Order of the offers: isk_per_lp (default, best first, offers without a value last), lp_cost (cheapest first) or name

function.name: get_npc_stations
function.description: List NPC stations, and find mission agents (for example the nearest level 4 security agent). With only system_name it lists that system's stations with owner and operation: use it for 'stations in X' or 'where can I dock'. With near, region, services, agent or limit it searches stations, nearest first (by gate jumps from near.origin), with owner, services, the refinery yield (Reprocessing Plant stations) and the matching agents, up to 50 per call with the total. Every agent in this build sits at a station, so 'nearest level 4 security agent to Dodixie' is the nearest station with such an agent. Example: {"near":{"origin":"Dodixie","max_jumps":5},"agent":{"level":4,"division":"security"},"limit":3}. Another: stations within 1 jump of Dodixie with repair facilities: {"near":{"origin":"Dodixie","max_jumps":1},"services":["Repair Facilities"]}.

system_name.description: Solar system name, e.g. 'Hek', 'Jita'. Alone it lists that system's stations; with search parameters it limits the search to that system.

near.description: Rank stations by gate jumps from an origin system, nearest first, e.g. {"origin":"Dodixie","max_jumps":5}. Without max_jumps every reachable system is ranked.

origin.description: Solar system name the jumps are counted from, e.g. 'Dodixie'

max_jumps.description: Keep stations at most this many jumps away (1-30)

prefer_high_sec.description: Count jumps through highsec where a highsec-only route exists, else through any space

services.description: Station services a station must all offer, e.g. ['Repair Facilities', 'Reprocessing Plant']. Same names as find_systems station_services.

agent.description: Keep stations with at least one matching agent, and list those agents, e.g. {"level":4,"division":"security"} or {"kind":"research","faction":"Gallente Federation"}.

division.description: Agent division: security, distribution, mining or research (R&D)

kind.description: Agent kind (default mission, the ordinary mission agent)

faction.description: Faction name, e.g. 'Gallente Federation'; keeps the agents of its corporations

locator.description: true keeps only agents that offer the locator service

function.name: get_reprocessing_yield
function.description: Compute the materials produced by reprocessing an EVE item (ore, ice, salvage, modules). Use for 'how many minerals from X Veldspar' or 'reprocessing yield' questions.

quantity.description: Number of units to reprocess (default: one batch, e.g. 100 for most ores)

function.name: get_required_skills
function.description: List the skills required to fly a ship or build an item, for one item (item_name) or up to 20 at once (items). Use for 'what skills to fly X' or 'what skills to build Y' questions. With training_time it adds the skill points and the training time from zero SP for an Omega clone; without attributes each skill is at its best remap (27/21). Several items also get the union of their skills, each at its highest level.

item_name.description: Ship or blueprint name, e.g. 'Avatar', 'Nyx', 'Revelation', 'Damage Control II'

items.description: Up to 20 item names for a plan with one line each, e.g. ['Paladin', 'Rifter']; item_name given beside it is added to the list

purpose.description: 'fly' for ship/module skills (default), 'build' for blueprint manufacturing skills

training_time.description: true: add SP and the training time from zero SP for an Omega clone, e.g. for 'how long to train into a Paladin'. Without attributes each skill is trained at its best remap (primary 27 / secondary 21, no implants, 37.5 SP/min).

attributes.description: The character's five attributes, all or none, e.g. {'perception': 20, 'memory': 20, 'willpower': 20, 'intelligence': 20, 'charisma': 19}; each skill then trains by its own two attributes. Only used with training_time.

function.name: get_average_prices
function.description: EVE's average price for up to 200 items in one call, by name (names) or type ID (type_ids), from ESI /markets/prices (refreshed daily, one shared copy). It is an average of recent trades across New Eden, not live Jita buy or sell orders: say so when you quote it. Use get_market_price for the live order book of one item.

names.description: Exact item names, e.g. ['Tritanium', 'PLEX', 'Gila']; up to 200 together with type_ids

type_ids.description: Item type IDs, e.g. [34, 44992]; up to 200 together with names

function.name: get_market_history
function.description: Daily market history of one item in one region from ESI (/markets/{region_id}/history), summarised: average, low, high and volume per day or per week over the last 1-90 days, and the change from the first to the last bucket. Name the item (item_name) or give type_id; pick a hub (jita, amarr, dodixie, rens, hek) or a region name (default The Forge). Use for 'is X trending up' or 'how much X trades per day'.

type_id.description: The EVE type ID of the item (e.g. 34 for Tritanium). Use this or item_name.

item_name.description: Exact item name, e.g. 'PLEX' or 'Tritanium'. Use this or type_id.

hub.description: Trade hub whose region to read, e.g. 'amarr'. Wins over region. Omit for The Forge.

region.description: Region name, e.g. 'Domain' or 'Sinq Laison'. Default The Forge. PLEX always uses the global PLEX market.

days.description: Length of the window in days, 1 to 90 (default 30), ending at the newest day ESI has

bucket.description: Size of one row: 'week' (ISO weeks, Monday to Sunday; default) or 'day'

function.name: get_sovereignty
function.description: Get who holds sovereignty (alliance and corporation, or NPC faction) over EVE solar systems. Live data from ESI. Pass systems (up to 50 names) for one line per system with the holders' names; system_name (one system) is the older form and answers with ids only. Use for 'who controls X' or 'sov holder of Y' questions.

system_name.description: Solar system name, e.g. 'Saranen' (single system; the older form, answers ids only)

systems.description: Up to 50 solar system names, e.g. ['1DQ1-A', 'Jita']: one line each, with the alliance and corporation names or the NPC faction

function.name: get_system_activity
function.description: Get the activity of EVE solar systems in the last hour from ESI. Pass systems (up to 50 names) for one line per system with jumps, ship kills, pod kills and NPC kills; system_name (one system) is the older form and answers kills only. Use for 'how busy is X', 'how many kills in Y recently', 'is it safe to undock'.

system_name.description: Solar system name, e.g. 'Tama' (single system; kills only)

systems.description: Up to 50 solar system names, e.g. ['1DQ1-A', 'Jita']: one line each, with jumps, ship kills, pod kills and NPC kills of the last hour

function.name: find_systems
function.description: Find solar systems by filters and rank them: security band, region, constellation, faction, wormhole class, NPC station and its services, asteroid belts, planet types, ice belts (EVE University's list of highsec and lowsec ice systems) and distance from an origin (near). One line per system, up to 100 per call (page with offset), with the total. Example, the three nearest highsec Clear Icicle systems to C-N4OD: {"security":{"min":0.45},"ice_types":["Clear Icicle"],"near":{"origin":"C-N4OD"},"sort":"jumps","limit":3}. Set jump_range {origin, ship, jump_drive_calibration (default 5)} to keep the systems that ship can jump to from the origin (cyno-able: lowsec or nullsec, not wormhole space, Pochven or Zarzakh; 'Jump Bridge' = Ansiblex reach), with the light-years, sorted nearest first; e.g. the nearest lowsec NPC-station systems a Rorqual can reach from EC-P8R: {"jump_range":{"origin":"EC-P8R","ship":"Rorqual"},"security":{"min":0.1,"max":0.4},"has_npc_station":true,"limit":3}.

near.description: Rank by gate jumps from an origin system and leave out systems with no gate route, e.g. {"origin":"C-N4OD","max_jumps":10}. Without max_jumps every reachable system is ranked.

origin.description: Solar system name the jumps are counted from, e.g. 'C-N4OD'

max_jumps.description: Keep systems at most this many jumps away (1-30)

prefer_high_sec.description: Count jumps through highsec where a highsec-only route exists, else through any space (the line says '(no highsec-only route)')

jump_range.description: Keep the systems a ship can jump to from an origin, with the light-years, nearest first, e.g. {"origin":"EC-P8R","ship":"Rorqual"}.

origin.description: Solar system name the jump starts in, e.g. 'EC-P8R' (lowsec or nullsec)

ship.description: Hull name, e.g. 'Rorqual', 'Rhea', 'Avatar', or 'Jump Bridge' for Ansiblex jump bridges

jump_drive_calibration.description: Jump Drive Calibration level 0-5 (default 5); it sets the range

security.description: Security band as shown in game, e.g. 0.5 includes systems with true security 0.45-0.5: {"min":0.5} is highsec, {"max":0.4} is lowsec and below. Wormhole systems carry a security of about -1.0; filter them with wormhole_class (7, 8 and 9 are known-space highsec, lowsec and nullsec).

wormhole_class.description: Wormhole class: 1-6 for C1-C6, 7 highsec, 8 lowsec, 9 nullsec, 12 Thera, 13 shattered frigate holes, 14-18 Drifter, 25 Pochven

has_npc_station.description: true for systems with an NPC station, false for systems without

station_services.description: Station services every match must offer, e.g. ['Reprocessing Plant', 'Factory']; an unknown name lists the valid ones

min_asteroid_belts.description: At least this many asteroid belts, e.g. 3

planet_types.description: Planet types the system must have at least one of each, e.g. ['Lava', 'Gas']; an unknown name lists the valid ones

has_ice_belt.description: true for systems EVE University lists with ice belts, false for systems it does not list (nullsec ice systems are not covered)

ice_types.description: Ice types, e.g. ['Clear Icicle', 'Blue Ice']; a system matches when it has any of them; implies has_ice_belt

sort.description: Order: jumps (needs near; the default with near), security (most secure first), name (the default) or ly (needs jump_range; the default with jump_range)

offset.description: Systems to skip, to read the next page (default 0)

function.name: get_system_info
function.description: Facts about up to 50 solar systems in one call: security, region, constellation, faction, wormhole class and effect, neighbouring systems (stargates), counts of asteroid belts, moons, planets by type and NPC stations, and the ice belt when EVE University lists one. One line per system.

systems.description: Up to 50 solar system names, e.g. ['Jita', 'Erkinen']: one line each

function.name: get_thera_connections
function.description: Live wormhole connections from Thera and Turnur into known space and wormhole space, from EvE-Scout (Signal Cartel's public scanning data; credit them as EvE-Scout / Signal Cartel). One line per connection: the exit system with its security and region, wormhole type and largest ship size, hours left and both signature ids. Set near {origin, max_jumps} to keep the exits closest to a system, sorted by jumps. Connections change every few hours.

near.description: Keep the exits with a gate route to an origin system and sort them by jumps, e.g. {"origin":"Jita","max_jumps":10}. Exits with no gate route from the origin are left out (counted in the answer).

origin.description: Solar system name the jumps are counted from, e.g. 'Jita'

max_jumps.description: Keep exits at most this many jumps away (1-30); omit to rank every exit with a gate route

limit.description: Most connections to list (1-50, default 20); the answer says how many more there are

function.name: convert_isk_to_real
function.description: Convert an ISK amount to real-world USD/EUR via the PLEX exchange rate. Returns the indicative real-money value with disclaimers (Fenris Creations forbids RMT — for context only). Use for 'how much USD is X ISK', 'real-money cost of Y battle', 'is this Titan worth IRL'.

isk_amount.description: Amount in ISK to convert (e.g. 95_000_000_000 for 95 B ISK)
